No deprecated packages detected (expo-av not imported; expo-video + expo-audio used correctly). No SafeAreaView issues.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth via localStorage['gh_session_token']='smoketok-fresh-2026' (founder, Sentinel) or 'smoketok-fresh-2026-u2' (Sovereign). Bioscan wheel pickers use pattern `bs-<field>-sheet-{plus|minus|confirm}`. Longevity wheel fields (lg-birth/height/weight) are inside UPRAVIŤ PROFIL modal — click that button first. Live gpt-5.4 chat takes ~5-15s; memory extraction is async ~5-10s after chat; briefing is cached per day and requires ?force=true to regenerate.
